summary: A Quote during the closing auction: the quote fields as usual; the web also publishes the indicative equilibrium price, reference price, equilibrium and imbalance quantities and the auction flag.

deviations.reason: The web sends Upstox's closing-auction fields, from the tick that carried them; the desktop's decoder reads them (proto.rs) and the common carrier drops them (audit P-11; lane wire must carry them, then the Upstox decoder fills them per tick, keeping the sign of the imbalance).
